descriptionChirho: Grain or cereal (especially wheat) as agricultural produce or commodity; all 6 languages use a single consistent translation equivalent throughout all 40 occurrences (eng 'grain', spa 'grano/trigo', hin 'अनाज/अन्न', arb 'حِنْطَة/قَمْح', kor '곡식', swa 'nafaka'), with variation only in grammatical inflection (article, construct, possessive suffixes, conjunctions, prepositions) and no semantic differentiation
